s: Bay Strip Miters are the same as strip miters but work on corners that are 45 degrees as opposed to 90 degree corners. Adjoining gutters need to be cut at 22.5 degrees each.

Bay miters function in the same way as strip miters except with a 45 degree bend instead of 90 degrees. Bay miters require two adjoining gutters to be cut on 22.5 angles and are preferred by contractors who only want one seam per corner.

A Bay Strip Miter is a narrow piece of aluminum with a 45° bend that fits over the gutter seam and screws or rivets into adjoining gutters on an outside or inside corner, resulting in a one-seam corner.
